items.difficulty_reason: H3: the actual author core connects mixed integral Hodge filtrations, universal-extension uniformization and noncommutative Heisenberg actions to a lifted self-duality tensor and an explicit stabilizer. Its integral orbit quotient is then identified with the Ribet section image, establishing specialness and algebraic compatibility. All local uniformization/stabilizer proofs are supplied, not just the final39line proof.
